units.source_text: 翌日上午九时许，汉子又到我的住处来访。

en.t: At about nine o'clock the next morning, the man came to visit me at my lodging again.

units.source_text: 我刚起床，邀他一同去洗澡。

en.t: I had just gotten up, and invited him to go bathe with me.

units.source_text: 南伊豆是小阳春天气，一尘不染，晶莹透明，实在美极了。

en.t: Southern Izu had the clear mild weather of Indian summer, spotless and crystalline; it was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 在浴池下方上涨的小河，沐浴着暖融融的阳光。

en.t: The swollen stream below the bathhouse was bathed in warm sunlight.

units.source_text: 昨夜的烦躁，自己也觉得如梦似幻。

en.t: Even to me, last night's agitation now felt like a dream or an illusion.
